Requirement slug: matrix-darkmode-colors

Task: fix(matrix): dark mode colors. Look at src/coord/matrix/* (MatrixModel.ts, MatrixView.ts) and the dark theme file (grep for darkMode / theme/dark). Report the matrix default colors (borderColor, backgroundColor, divider color) and where dark theme overrides component defaults.

Do NOT modify any files. Read the relevant code carefully (use rg/grep and Read). Your job is to produce an accurate, concrete implementation plan that another engineer can apply directly without re-reading much.

Requirements for your report:
- List every repo-relative file path that needs editing.
- Quote the EXACT current code (with file:line) at each site that must change.
- Give the exact replacement code where it is under ~40 lines.

Be precise and complete. Accuracy matters more than brevity, but do not dump whole files - quote only the relevant regions.

content.text: I have everything I need. Here is the analysis.

input.risks:
Ambiguity / things to watch:

1. Exact shade choice. The removed hardcoded values (`'#817f91'` outer border, `'#484753'` inner border) are lighter/more purple than the token-derived ones (`rgba(165,166,171,1)` and `rgba(40,43,48,1)`). Using tokens is what every other block in `src/theme/dark.ts` does and it preserves the light-mode contrast relationships exactly, but if a reviewer wants the previous visual weight, the knobs are `color.borderShade`/`color.neutral40` for the outer border and `color.neutral25`/`color.border` for the inner cell borders. No other file encodes an expectation about these hexes.

2. Non-overwriting merge (`zrUtil.merge(option, themeModel.get(this.mainType))`, src/model/Component.ts:170) means anything the theme sets can never be restored by `defaultOption`. That is why `matrix.corner.itemStyle.borderColor` must stay unset — setting it would give dark mode corner-cell borders that light mode lacks (`makeDefaultCellItemStyleOption(true)` yields `borderColor: 'none'`, MatrixModel.ts:229).

3. Object sharing in the theme. `matrixAxis` is used for both `x` and `y`. That is safe: zrender's `merge` clones source sub-objects into the target and never mutates the source. But do NOT reuse `matrixAxis` for `body` — `dividerLineStyle` is only meaningful on `matrix.x`/`matrix.y` (`MatrixDimensionOption.dividerLineStyle`, MatrixModel.ts:154; consumed at MatrixView.ts:117/129); hence the separate `matrixBody`/`matrixCorner` objects.

4. No inheritance from the matrix root. `MatrixView.ts:198` uses `matrixModel.getShallow(bodyCornerOptionRoot, true)` and `MatrixModel.optionUpdated` (MatrixModel.ts:295-296) uses `this.get('x'|'y', true)` — all with `ignoreParent: true`. So there is no shortcut like `matrix: { label: { color } }`; every branch must be listed explicitly. Same reason the theme cannot rely on the global `theme.textStyle.color` (src/theme/dark.ts:89-91): `defaultLabelOption.color` is an explicit value that wins over the global text style.

5. Type safety will not catch mistakes here — `ThemeOption = Dictionary<any>` (src/util/types.ts:828) and `dark.ts`'s `theme` is an untyped object literal, which is exactly how `backgroundColor`/`innerBackgroundStyle` slipped in. No type declaration needs to change; consider (optional, out of scope) typing the theme literal against the component option types to prevent recurrence.

6. Tests: there are NO matrix or theme unit tests. `test/ut/spec/` contains only api, component/{dataZoom,graphic,helper,visualMap}, data, model, scale, series, util — grep for "matrix" and "dark" under `test/ut` returns nothing. Verification must be visual: `test/matrix.html`, `test/matrix2.html`, `test/matrix3.html`, `test/matrix_application.html`, `test/matrix_application2.html` all currently init with the default theme; switch one to `echarts.init(dom, 'dark')` (the pattern used in `test/gauge.html:43` and `test/theme.html:42`) to inspect, or add a dedicated dark matrix test page. Check all four surfaces: header/body/corner label text, body cell borders, header divider lines, outer border.

7. `src/coord/matrix/MatrixModel.ts` and `src/component/matrix/MatrixView.ts` need no edits — they read the token values at module-init time for the light defaults, which is the intended design; only the theme layer changes.
